title: Complaint by Central Authority or authorised officer

content.general_rule: No cognizance shall be taken by a competent court of any offence under sections 88 and 89
content.exception: except on a complaint filed by the Central Authority or any officer authorised by it
conditions: except on a complaint filed by the Central Authority or any officer authorised by it in this behalf.
